aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab develops practical software for food truck and mobile catering businesses: online ordering, collection times, fewer questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We develop practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering businesses: we help them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was founded to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software offered to them is designed with businesses that have a fixed address in mind.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: to make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After founding Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover food trucks coming to their area, I spent time getting to know the challenges mobile food businesses face more closely. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.fit.marketplacesBody: Food delivery platforms bring new customers but take commission on every order. Uber Eats states 14% commission for pickup orders and 30% for delivery by Uber couriers in Germany. Wolt says on its own website that it takes commission but gives no rate. We could not check Lieferando’s rates. That commission also applies to your regular customers who pre-order from you.
comparison.fit.oursBody: you sell at changing locations, want pre-orders with a pickup time, don’t want your kitchen overloaded and don’t want to be tied to a contract.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or financial year; ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you don’t need to confirm each one individually.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you hand out a buzzer, add the buzzer number to the order; know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and that they’re ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map; nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your documents such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety in one place. We remind you before they expire; you can send the documents to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links directly to its own order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with their own prices and settings, for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot fills up, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital loyalty cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items in deals and raise the average order value by suggesting extras at checkout.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram questions.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your staff their own login details with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If signal drops, online ordering is paused, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders while offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take payment by card in advance via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a last order time for items that need preparation in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, each with its own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each item costs you; see what you really earned at each event, not just your turnover.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times automatically for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it fades out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a stock count; it counts down as orders come in, and the item sells out automatically when it runs out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments with a compatible phone; you no longer need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets from a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time; demand is spread across your service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders on the spot at the food truck; take payment with your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-reply: answer WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule automatically.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can’t choose that time.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — and together with the card terminal you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same opening hours every week. You, on the other hand, work somewhere else every week, at different times, in places where mobile signal is weak or absent. HatchGrab was developed exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If signal drops, online ordering is paused automatically, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times; it’s ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and pick a collection time. Shorter queues, food ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Designed for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” While you’re driving to the trading spot or at the grill, your WhatsApp messages are answered with your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp messages will be answered while you’re driving to the trading spot or at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will come after.
